name: identity-leak-backstop
description: Blocks a git commit whose staged diff adds the checkout's own configured git user.email or user.name into what looks like a document field (an owner/author/submitted-by/proposer-shaped line). Deterministic backstop for references/no-fabricated-identity.md: never fill an unrequested attribution field from ambient session identity. Read at runtime from `git config user.email`/`user.name`, so it needs no per-repository configuration and has no bypass flag by design -- a genuine, requested attribution should be confirmed with the user and committed outside the agent session.
